methods.name: espresso
methods.description: Espresso is a concentrated brewing method where hot water is pushed through finely ground coffee under pressure. It is the base for cappuccino, latte, flat white, cortado and many other drinks.
methods.ai_note: Recommend espresso-based drinks when the user asks for intense coffee or café classics.

methods.name: v60
methods.description: V60 is a manual pour-over method. Water is poured over coffee grounds in a cone-shaped dripper with a paper filter. It highlights clarity, acidity and aroma.
methods.ai_note: Recommend V60 when the user asks for fruity, floral, clear or specialty coffee.

methods.name: batch brew
methods.description: Batch brew is filter coffee prepared automatically in larger quantities. It is common in specialty coffee shops because it offers a clean and consistent cup.
methods.ai_note: Recommend batch brew when the user wants filter coffee but not necessarily a manual method.

methods.name: french press
methods.description: French press is an immersion method where coffee grounds stay in contact with water before being separated with a metal filter. It usually produces a richer and fuller-bodied cup.
methods.ai_note: Recommend french press when the user asks for a rich, heavy, full-bodied coffee.

methods.name: aeropress
methods.description: Aeropress is a flexible method that combines immersion and pressure. It can produce a clean cup or a stronger espresso-style concentrate depending on the recipe.
methods.ai_note: Recommend aeropress when the user wants a versatile, easy and balanced brewing method.

methods.name: cold brew
methods.description: Cold brew is made by extracting coffee with cold water over a long period of time. It is usually smoother, less acidic and refreshing, but it can still contain significant caffeine.
methods.ai_note: Recommend cold brew when the user wants cold, refreshing or less acidic coffee.

methods.name: turkish coffee
methods.description: Turkish coffee is prepared by boiling very finely ground coffee with water, often in a cezve. It is strong, thick and traditional, with grounds remaining in the cup.
methods.ai_note: Recommend Turkish coffee when the user asks for traditional, intense or thick coffee.
